name: Consistencia de Textura
description: Mide la variacion de detalle de textura entre regiones de la imagen.
mechanism: Computes GLCM texture características a través de multiple orientations and distances. AI images produce more uniform texture statistics, while real photos show natural spatial variation.
parameters: Distances: [1, 2, 4], Angles: [0, 45, 90, 135 degrees], Features: contraste, correlación, energy, homogeneity
accuracy: Moderada - 70-80% for detecting texture uniformity anomalías
source: Haralick et al. (1973), adapted by Qian et al. (2020)
useCase: Identificación de patrones de textura uniformes típicos de la IA

references.title: Ojala, T. et al. (2002). Multiresolution Gray-Scale and Rotation Invariant Texture Classification. IEEE TPAMI.
Liu, Z. et al. (2020). Global Texture Enhancement for Fake Face Detection in the Wild. CVPR.

strengths:
• Multi-directional análisis de textura through GLCM
• Captures spatial relationships entre pixels
• Effective for detecting uniform AI textures
• Well-established in image análisis literature
limitations:
• Uniform real surfaces (walls, sky) create falsos positivos
• Sensitive to image resolución changes
• Computation increases with number of distance/angle pairs
• Post-processing can normalize texture características
